effects.profit_basis: credits less debits on profit-and-loss heads above the Schedule III profit-before-tax line (item IX); tax expense (items X, XIII) and discontinuing operations (XII) are excluded (architecture D31)
effects.net_assets_basis: assets less liabilities: the signed movement, debit positive, of every line on an asset head (item II) or a liability head (items I(3), I(4)); equity heads (I(1)) are outside the sum, so a direct equity entry moves net assets; tax lines count only when the entry carries them, nothing is imputed (architecture D31)

band_basis: each effect banded on its absolute value against the current threshold version: below CTT clearly trivial, from CTT to PM inclusive accumulated, above PM individually significant (spec section 4); the item's band is the higher of the two (architecture D33)

banding.basis: each effect banded on its absolute value against the current threshold version: below CTT clearly trivial, from CTT to PM inclusive accumulated, above PM individually significant (spec section 4); the item's band is the higher of the two (architecture D33)

qualitative.escalation_basis: an item is escalated while at least one factor of the qualitative checklist is recorded against it, each with its reason (spec section 5); an escalated item is listed individually regardless of its size (acceptance 8) and is accumulated whatever its band, because a matter is clearly trivial only when it is clearly inconsequential 'whether judged by any criteria of size, nature or circumstances' (SA 450 paragraph A2; register F5; architecture D59); which factors apply is a person's judgement and is never detected (spec section 12)

checklist.text: affects compliance with a law, regulation or loan covenant
masks a change in earnings or a trend
changes a ratio used to evaluate the entity, including the eleven Schedule III ratios
relates to a fraud or a suspected fraud
relates to a related party transaction
affects segment information, or management remuneration
turns a loss into a profit, or the reverse
